faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is conducted by the District Climate Change Mission Theni (DCCM Theni) to fill available positions under environmental and climate initiatives in the district.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being recruited through this notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted for the position of Technical Assistant-I under a fixed contractual engagement period.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Technical Assistant-I?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant-I post in this recruitment notification released by DCCM Theni.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a degree in Biological Sciences, Environmental Science, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife Science, Public Policy, or related academic fields.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criteria before submitting their application documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Technical Assistant-I position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 22,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of offline applications is 12-10-2026. Applications must reach the designated address before or on this date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Interested candidates need to prepare their resume and documents and send them by post or in person.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the filled application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted directly to Room No. 21, District Climate Change Mission, District Collectorate, Theni District either by post or in person.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be engaged on a contract basis for a total duration of 19 months under the District Climate Change Mission Theni.
